intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both sit in {{cityA}}, and this page compares their recorded {{course}} fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in {{year}}.
Lexicon MILE vs PIBM Pune is not a single winner. PIBM Pune has a recorded NIRF 2025 #101, and Lexicon MILE has no NIRF rank on this page.

sections.heading: Lexicon MILE vs PIBM Pune for MBA / PGDM: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Lexicon MILE if you want a 2023 flagship package record of ₹9 LPA, and a recorded fee of ₹4.75 lakh, in a private MBA / PGDM setting at Pune.
Choose PIBM Pune if you want a recorded NIRF 2025 #101, and a 2023 flagship package record of ₹7 LPA, in a private MBA / PGDM setting at Pune.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short, executive or certificate rows when the picker can tell them apart. Always match the fee to the exact programme you will join.

Our records show ₹4.75 lakh as a tuition figure for Global MBA Finance at Lexicon MILE. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.
Our records show ₹11 lakh as a programme total for Global MBA at PIBM Pune.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Lexicon MILE's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹9 LPA and a highest package of ₹11 LPA on Post Graduate Diploma in Management - PGDM Finance. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.
PIBM Pune's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹7 LPA and a highest package of ₹17 LPA on MBA Digital Marketing. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Lexicon MILE is listed on our records with ATMA, CAT as an admission route for this MBA / PGDM comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.
PIBM Pune is listed on our records with CAT, MAH MBA CET as an admission route for this MBA / PGDM comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in {{cityA}}, Maharashtra. If you want to stay in this city, the choice is less about relocation and more about the classroom, fees and the admission route.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read each official hostel and location note, before you treat travel time or hostel cost as a given.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Use official fee notices rather than our raw minimums, then decide whether Lexicon MILE's recorded ₹4.75 lakh or PIBM Pune's ₹11 lakh fits your budget for this MBA / PGDM.
Use official fee notices rather than our raw minimums, then decide whether PIBM Pune's recorded ₹11 lakh or Lexicon MILE's ₹4.75 lakh fits your budget for this MBA / PGDM.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, Lexicon MILE or PIBM Pune?
faqs.answer: It depends on the programme you want. Lexicon MILE and PIBM Pune differ in more than one way: PIBM Pune has a recorded NIRF 2025 #101, and Lexicon MILE has no NIRF rank on this page.

faqs.question: What are the recorded fees for Lexicon MILE vs PIBM Pune?
faqs.answer: our records list ₹4.75 lakh for Lexicon MILE on Global MBA Finance; our records list ₹11 lakh for PIBM Pune on Global MBA. Confirm both official notices before you decide.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for Lexicon MILE and PIBM Pune?
faqs.answer: Lexicon MILE's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹9 LPA and a highest package of ₹11 LPA on Post Graduate Diploma in Management - PGDM Finance. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.

faqs.question: Which entrance exams do Lexicon MILE and PIBM Pune accept?
faqs.answer: Our records list ATMA, CAT for Lexicon MILE, and CAT, MAH MBA CET for PIBM Pune. Always confirm the current admission brochure, because tests and cut-offs change by year.

faqs.question: Are Lexicon MILE and PIBM Pune in the same city?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Pune, Maharashtra. The move is about the programme, fees and tests, not a change of city.

faqs.question: Should I treat this comparison as a final admission decision?
faqs.answer: No. Fees, eligibility and placements change by year and by programme. Verify the current official fee notice, admission brochure and placement report of each institute before you apply.
